anchor_scope: dev-sanity PASS procedure, sanity-stack, the sanity close hook's PASS precondition, templates/rebase-required.xml.j2; replaces ANC-062's lead-links clause
anchor_statement: On a sanity PASS the sanity side must link the checked PR as the new top of the phase stack before the close hook runs; when the checked head does not descend from the recorded top because another layer linked first, it must send the dev rebase-required on the dev's open task instead of linking, and the dev must rebase before every resubmission.

cases.text: Sanity PASS on branch A links A as the top; sanity PASS on branch B, cut from the old top, sends the dev rebase-required and writes nothing; the dev rebases B onto A and runs its hook again.
The lead links the layer when it reads the sanity PASS report, or sanity closes the dev's task and assigns QA with the PR still unlinked.

After a sanity PASS, dev-sanity links the PR as the new stack top and only then runs the close hook. If the head no longer descends from the recorded top because another PASS was linked first, it sends the dev rebase-required on the same task and links nothing; the dev rebases onto the new top before every resubmission.

cases.rationale: In-scope stacking bookkeeping, silent about link-before-close and rebase-required.
